owner.role: enforce delivery/decision handoff admissibility; never author canonical P-number definitions

purpose: Prevent architectural judgment, authorized executable work, and user-requested outcomes from being silently substituted with plans or delegated as ambiguous instructions.
precedence: Repository/platform safety, current operator intent, canonical upstream prompt authority, then this reusable admission contract. This contract cannot authorize mutation.

decision_policy.CLOSED: Nonempty chosen action, rejected alternative, rationale and referenced evidence.
decision_policy.CONDITIONAL: Executable observation probe plus at least two explicit distinguishable outcomes mapped to deterministic actions with bounded fallback.
decision_policy.UNRESOLVED: Must not pass a judgment-closed handoff; mark NEEDS_JUDGMENT or real blocker with evidence; never silently delegate.

evidence_policy.required: Stable source, revision, support scope, access class, and typed proof ceiling; self-asserted text is not proof of execution.
evidence_policy.forbidden: Credentials, private user/project details, invented provider readback or capabilities.

execution_policy.current_runtime: If safe authorized available work is within current-runtime owned scope, do it before a terminal handoff; otherwise record a concrete no-capability/authority gate.
execution_policy.delegation: Receiving agent receives selected mechanism and deterministic contingent branches, not 'choose implementation' without proof of an unavailable decision dependency.
execution_policy.safety: No plan, prompt, model vote, expert output or checklist supplies repository-write, merge, credential, deployment or live-target authorization.

proof_ceiling: Deterministic structural/cross-reference enforcement and adversarial fixtures. No validator can independently certify factual correctness of judgments, model competence, actual intent satisfaction, live mutation, or human emotional experience.
